notes.title: OFFICIAL PUBLISHER ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Hello revolutionaries!


We’re proud to announce that Dark Adelita is officially joining forces with indie.io!



As a small team of developers in Mexico, we started this project in February of this year with the purpose of making a game that not only showcases the beauty of our country, but also the history and strength of the Mexican people. It is a project that we’re really proud of and we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoy making it!



For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.



We chose to work with indie.io since they have a great track record with helping other indie games reach more players.



Check out the amazing games being published by indie.io! 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio



Don’t forget to wish list our game, and join our Discord community!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3575650/Dark_Adelita/"][/dynamiclink]

As always, I want to thank our community for always being with us, and supporting us through the development of our games!

-The Brain-dead Rabbit Games team
